shop_about_story: I’ve been working with laser technology since 2006. Over the years, I’ve created projects for some of the most important international fashion brands, where precision isn’t an added value, it’s the standard. Almost twenty years later, I decided to build something of my own. 2Z Creative Lab is the result: digital laser-cutting files created for makers, creatives, and enthusiasts of fantasy, gothic, and dark academia aesthetics. Dice boxes, candle holders, multilayer organizers, desk accessories, and decorative objects inspired by fantasy worlds and tabletop culture. Every project is designed, prototyped, and tested on a real machine before being published. There are no shortcuts: assemblies are verified by cutting, not by looking at a screen. I consider myself a technological craftsman. I use advanced tools, including AI, but I use them to support the process, not to replace it. Here you won’t find massive bundles filled with hundreds of mass-generated files that have never touched a real laser machine. This is what I mean when I talk about Artisan Intelligence.
